metadata.title: Helly complexes are Hellyfications of their boundaries
metadata.abstract: We prove that every finite Helly complex is isomorphic, at the level of its $1$-skeleton, to the Hellyfication (equivalently, the discrete injective hull) of its combinatorial boundary equipped with the metric induced from the complex. In particular, the boundary-rigidity phenomenon for Helly complexes proved by Blufstein-Chalopin-Chepoi admits a canonical injective-hull interpretation, independent of reconstruction procedures based on dismantling.

analysis.topic: 度量测度几何、极限与奇异空间
analysis.workSummary: 作者证明有限 Helly 复形的一维骨架可以由其组合边界的诱导度量取离散内射包得到。
analysis.breakthrough: 将既有边界刚性现象解释为典范的内射包构造，不依赖拆解式重构程序。
analysis.limitations: 对象是有限复形的一维骨架，并非一般复形全部高维结构。 本条依据官方摘要与评论整理，尚未核验正文证明；AI 披露以独立核查记录为准。

aiReview.note: 对该版本全部可提取页面做 AI 披露关键词检索，并核对命中段落；这不是对整篇数学证明的审读。

analysis.priorityReason: 为离散度量空间的边界重构提供概念清晰的工具。
